name: Festival International New Drama (FIND) 2026
description: From 16–26 April 2026, FIND showcases works by renowned directors and writers and exciting new discoveries from Brazil, Canada, Greece, the UK, Italy and Norway. Katie Mitchell is Artist in Focus, presenting stage adaptations including 'Bluets' by Maggie Nelson adapted by Margaret Perry, and 'Cow | Deer', a production that dispenses with words entirely, using sounds and noises to narrate a day in the life of animals.
